verses.text: This is what Isaiah son of Amoz saw about Judah and Jerusalem.
In the last days, the mountain of the LORD's house will be set up as the highest of the mountains. It will be raised above the hills, and all the nations will stream to it.

Many peoples will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths." For the teaching will go out from Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

He will judge between the nations and settle arguments for many peoples. They will beat their swords into plows and their spears into pruning tools. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, and they will never train for war again.
Come, people of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the LORD.
For you, LORD, have left your people, the house of Jacob, because they are full of customs from the east. They practice fortune telling like the Philistines, and they make deals with foreigners.
Their land is full of silver and gold, and there is no end to their treasures. Their land is full of horses, and there is no end to their chariots.
Their land is also full of idols. They worship things made with their own hands, things their own fingers have made.
So people will be brought low, and everyone will be humbled. Do not forgive them!
Go into the rocks and hide in the dust, away from the terror of the LORD and the glory of his majesty.
The proud looks of people will be brought low, and the pride of everyone will be humbled. The LORD alone will be lifted high on that day.
For the LORD of Armies has a day set aside for all who are proud and arrogant, for all who are lifted up, and they will be brought low.
It will come against all the tall, lofty cedars of Lebanon, and all the oaks of Bashan,
against all the high mountains, against all the lofty hills,
against every tall tower, against every strong wall,
against all the ships of Tarshish, and against every beautiful thing people admire.
The pride of people will be humbled, and the arrogance of everyone will be brought low. The LORD alone will be lifted high on that day.
The idols will completely disappear.
People will run into caves in the rocks and holes in the ground, away from the terror of the LORD and the glory of his majesty, when he rises to shake the earth powerfully.
On that day people will throw away their idols of silver and gold, which they made for themselves to worship. They will throw them to the moles and the bats.
They will run into the caves of the rocks and the cracks in the rough cliffs, away from the terror of the LORD and the glory of his majesty, when he rises to shake the earth powerfully.
Stop trusting in mere humans, who have only a breath in their nostrils. What are they worth?
